name: OrderFusion Lite – Order Filters, Columns & Export for WooCommerce
author: SpellDot

sections.description:
Stop clicking into every WooCommerce order to find product details, customer information, or order notes. OrderFusion Lite puts the missing information directly in your orders list.

Search and filter orders by product name, order status, shipping method, payment method, total amount, date range, or customer name. Combine filters and see results instantly.

Add columns for Products list, Customer Note, Phone, and Email. Toggle and reorder columns from Screen Options.

Export to CSV – export selected orders or all filtered results. Batch processing handles thousands of orders without timeouts.

Works with HPOS – fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and legacy post-based orders.

Uses native WordPress controls – manage columns and filters through Screen Options. Each user saves their own preferences.

No external requests – runs entirely in admin. No tracking, no customer data leaves your server.

License

This plugin is released under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Full license terms are available at https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

Third Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following open source libraries:

  • Flatpickr – Lightweight date picker for date filters (MIT License)
    Source: https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr

  • Tooltipster – Tooltip library for UI hints (MIT License)
    Source: https://github.com/iamceege/tooltipster
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin package to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it through Plugins >> Add New >> Upload Plugin.

  2. Activate “Order Filters, Columns & Export for WooCommerce” via Plugins >> Installed Plugins.

  3. Go to WooCommerce >> Orders and click Screen Options (top right) to manage columns and filters.

  4. To export orders to CSV, use bulk actions “Export selected to CSV” or “Export All to CSV”.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. All operations support HPOS order tables.

Does the plugin work with WordPress multisite?

Yes. Settings save separately per site.

Does this plugin affect front-end loading speed?

No. The plugin runs only in admin and loads no front-end assets.

Can I open exported CSV files in Excel or Google Sheets?

Yes. CSV files use standard formatting and open in Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers, and LibreOffice.
